items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Bird had the band, I think it was Bird and Red Rodney at this time. And they were the two horns.

ctx.x: Three Deuces, was Slam's manager, so that meant that we stayed there, most of the time, you know.

And so consequently we worked opposite all of the jazz groups. Bird -- did I mention I worked opposite Bird there? Well, any way, I don't know whether I told this story before, but if I did you stop me. Bird had the band, I think it was Bird and Red Rodney at this time. And they were the two horns. So Bird would -- this particular night Bird came on, and played about eight choruses right away, just first he got on and he really cooked. And he got off the stand and then Red started to solo. And right opposite the…
But also Sid Catlett had a band, after Bird, and this was John Simmons, and I don't know who all. A very good band.
